thread:
mike.sales: Heads upAcme wants a SOC2 excerpt + signed pen-test attestation for the POC. They also asked if we can give ephemeral KMS creds for their auditors to run an external scan. Any ops/security blockers?
anya.se: We can do ephemeral creds for staging, but need confirmation on outbound network egress and S3 presigned upload pattern.
lucas.sec: Two items from security: (1) pen-test attestation needs the customer's signer name filled; we can provide a draft. (2) For Private deployments, ephemeral KMS requires an approval from the KMS owner and a 1-page runbook.
mike.sales: Customer wants everything by EOW. Can we produce the draft pen-test letter + SOC2 redacted bundle by Friday COB?
dena.pm: I'll assemble a minimal evidence bundle. Lucas, confirm the redaction rules we should apply to the SOC2 snapshot.
lucas.sec: Use standard redaction: remove internal IP ranges and any amber hostnames. I'll add the redaction checklist to the folder. Audit-bot: SOC2 snapshot (redacted) ready: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/acmepoc-2026-03-20.zip
anya.se: For ephemeral KMS we need from the customer: (a) staging CIDR(s) for firewall allowlist, (b) desired key rotation window. Note: Dedicated single-tenant KMS adds to the monthly cost.
mike.sales: CIDRs already provided. I'll confirm rotation window. Please add the Dedicated+KMS delta to the quote.
anya.se: Rough estimate: Dedicated + KMS isolation = +$3,500/mo (TBD after infra signoff).
lucas.sec: Also need the pen-test signatory contact. If they request an independent red-team validation rather than our attestation, expect ~2 extra weeks.
dena.pm: Evidence checklist I'm preparing: 1) SOC2 redacted report 2) Network diagram 3) Pen-test draft 4) KMS keyflow diagram 5) Presigned upload snippet 6) Ephemeral creds runbook
mike.sales: presigned example for devs?
anya.se: presign example:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/acme-poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
lucas.sec: Security note: use <=1h expiry and single-use telemetry. We log request_id with the presigned access.
mike.sales: Customer also asked if the pen-test letter can explicitly say we support on-prem HSM integrations. Safe to include?
lucas.sec: Ok to state: "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations." Do not list specific HSM vendors unless tested.
dena.pm: I'll upload the SOC2 excerpt, redaction checklist, and pen-test draft to the shared folder and loop in Legal for quick review.
audit-bot: Pen-test-attestation-template_v1.docx uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_v1.docx
mike.sales: Thanks all. I'll send the bundle to Acme and request signer details. Will report back if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
